violations.text: During inspection, there was no one food safety certified. Establishment has a food safety manager, but their FMC has expired and they are on vacation. There must be an on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 11/05/2026
